subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: After the restart-startup failure regression is fixed, should forced post-clean-shutdown process.exit(0), strict internal /healthz?strict=1 recovery probing, and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS become the Gateway recovery contract?
rationale: The mitigation targets a real availability failure, but it intentionally changes process-exit and supervised duplicate-start behavior and adds an operator-facing env surface, so automation should not make that product/upgrade decision.

options.title: Repair Then Accept Contract
options.body: Fix the in-process restart startup-failure gap first, then land after Gateway-owner review accepts the forced-exit and strict-probe behavior.

options.title: Keep Timeout Internal
options.body: Remove the env override before merge if maintainers do not want a supported operator knob for this watchdog timeout.

options.title: Require Deployed Restart Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a branch-deployed supervised shutdown/restart run proves the full recovery loop on a real host.

recommendation.title: Repair Then Accept Contract
recommendation.body: Fix the in-process restart startup-failure gap first, then land after Gateway-owner review accepts the forced-exit and strict-probe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on Gateway live probes and supervised lock recovery, which are the central product contracts in this PR.
